notes: External native getter (property with `external get`) matching libogg ogg_page_version(og); returns the Ogg stream format version encoded in the page header (currently always 0). No direct call sites found in the repo (OggPage instances are only passed opaquely between OggSyncState.pageOut/OggStreamState.pageIn in OggMediaStream.kt), but the name matches the libogg C API 1:1 so kept as-is.
External native getter matching libogg ogg_page_continued(og); true if this page continues a packet begun on a previous page. Kept as-is; matches libogg naming convention used throughout this class.
Public external native getter matching libogg ogg_page_serialno(og); returns the logical bitstream serial number this page belongs to. Kept as-is.
Private external native getter matching libogg ogg_page_eos(og); true if this is the final page of the logical bitstream. Kept as-is (consistent with OggStreamState.isEOS in the same package).

Private external native getter matching libogg ogg_page_granulepos(og); raw 64-bit granule position (codec-specific timestamp) encoded in the page header. Kept as-is; note this is a raw Long value, distinct from the jagtheora.theora.GranulePos wrapper class used elsewhere in the decode pipeline.
Public external native getter matching libogg ogg_page_bos(og); true if this is the first page of the logical bitstream.

External native destructor overriding SimplePeer.clear(); releases the native ogg_page peer. Naming consistent with every other SimplePeer subclass in jagtheora (clear() = native dispose, called by SimplePeer.a()/finalize()).
Private external native getter matching libogg ogg_page_pageno(og); sequence number of this page within its logical bitstream.
Private external native getter matching libogg ogg_page_packets(og); count of packets that are fully completed (start and end) on this page, per libogg documentation. Kept as-is.
